name: Gunslinger
summary: Gunslinger; Once per turn, you can reload a pistol without using an action.  Gunslinger; Once per short rest, make one pistol attack as a bonus action after taking the Attack action.  Gunslinger; Your first pistol hit each turn deals +1d6 damage if the target is within 30 ft.
descriptionMarkdown:
Gunslinger; Once per turn, you can reload a pistol without using an action.

Gunslinger; Once per short rest, make one pistol attack as a bonus action after taking the Attack action.

Gunslinger; Your first pistol hit each turn deals +1d6 damage if the target is within 30 ft.
